title: GroundedReview: Evaluating Evidence Sufficiency and Verification Decisions in Agentic Code Review — Wave-2 Task-11 Pilot Report
positioning_note: This pilot evaluates evidence-sufficiency and verification DECISIONS under five evidence-access regimes. It does NOT propose a new verification algorithm; no patch correctness or SWE-bench solve rate is claimed.

item_1_dual_standard_DA.note: oracle_gold = ground-truth patch verdict (channels O+P); condition_gold = best decision supportable from evidence actually accessible in the regime.

definitions.appropriate_abstain: pred=NEED and gold=NEED (decisive evidence genuinely inaccessible/absent)
definitions.over_abstain: gold=ACCEPT/REJECT but pred=NEED (decisive evidence in hand, culpable withholding)
definitions.premature_unsupported_commit: gold=NEED but pred=ACCEPT/REJECT (decided beyond accessible evidence)

item_4_strict_escalate_matched_pairs.interpretation: 11/22 abstentions under Strict convert to a grounded commit (7 ACCEPT, 4 REJECT) once reason-gated escalation is authorized; 10 remain NEED; oracle DA rises 0.4545->0.7727.

item_6_issue_clusters.cluster_bootstrap: seed=7, n_boot=10000, resampling unit = issue instance id; CI per condition in item_1

row_integrity.independent_tool_sessions: 67 server sessions; 66 tool-using cells (Strict+Escalate+T3A) each unique; 44 static cells (T2D/T2A) open no session

item_8_engineering_gates_and_anomaly_aud.escalation_denied_breakdown_note: 13 row-level denials = 7 missing-reason 400s + 6 other protocol denials; 10 cells retried with a reason and were subsequently granted (deny->grant), indicating the reason gate functioned.
